items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: There's Happy Shillin and Georgie Borth, Johnny Fisher, and I and Johnny... who was the drummer... in that outfit.

ctx.x: No head. But what year do you think that was? About 1915? No, that was 16. Yeah. Then,

I went back to Chicago with Happy Shillin. There's Happy Shillin and Georgie Borth, Johnny Fisher, and I and Johnny, let's say I think it was Johnny Frisco, who was the drummer. No, Williams was the drummer in that outfit. Then we went to work in a place called the Orsonia. Mike Fritzlant's joint on, it was all Madison near Paulina. And we did all right there until they booted us out of there. So we went down to the corner and went to work for Tommy Thomas. And everybody was well satisfied. You see, uh, Brown's…
Who was managing that, uh? Happy Shillin. He and Fisher left? And, uh, Freddie Williams. Uh-huh.
